specs.英文简介: The Superzoom 105G is a 35mm compact camera from Olympus released in 2002.[https://web.archive.org/web/20150323095818/http://www.olympus-global.com/en/news/2002a/nr020611sza105ge.jsp Olympus Announces Superzoom 105G Compact 35mm Camera] at [https://web.archive.org/web/20150315081139/http://www.olympus-global.com/en/news/ Olympus news release] (archived) It is also known as the Infinity Zoom 105.
